author: Louis Rossmann
description:
FULU exists to reform laws that make it illegal to break digital locks on hardware that you've paid for & to push back against anti-ownership practices in the US. We are traveling the country to meet with people who are fed up enough with how things are going, that they're willing to do something about it. We're mobilizing people to push their congressional representatives to action.

This is an outtake from tonight's event. The rest I will show later. It is 1 AM, so it is time to sleep, but wanted to post this before I went to bed. 

Find us at https://fulu.org , and  https://advocates.fulu.org
title: outtake from FULU tour in San Jose(more coming later)
